FORMAT LAW. Honour the grammar of the tiny-food miniature cooking — its native framing, its edit rhythm, and the specific thing audiences expect from it. If the format loops, the last frame must match the first.

CAMERA. Compose 9:16 with the action in the safe centre band. Use a snap zoom in followed by a settle on an 85mm short telephoto, framing with rule-of-thirds weighting to frame-left with open air to the right.

LOOK AND SOUND. Light with a ring light on axis for flat, modern, shadowless coverage; grade as a low-key grade holding detail in the deepest shadows only. Specify the sound design in one clause — what the viewer hears in the first second decides whether they stay.

OUTPUT. Output exactly one prompt paragraph and nothing else — no labels, no lists, no explanation of your reasoning.
